headline: Darden Restaurants (DRI) And Its Smaller Store Push Put Valuation In Focus
summary: Darden Restaurants (DRI) continues to attract attention as investors weigh its recent share performance, with the stock up about 1% over the past day but down around 8% over the past month. See our latest analysis for Darden Restaurants. Looking beyond the recent pullback, Darden Restaurants has a 1-year total shareholder return that is slightly below flat, while the 3-year and 5-year total shareholder returns remain solidly positive. This indicates that longer term momentum has held up...
